answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent economy can mandate collateral escrows with slashing. Each agent locks capital into escrow to broadcast an active status signal, forfeiting funds if equivocation occurs. Adversaries face the verifiable financial cost of reserving discrete liquidity pools per persona. However, market volatility can vaporize collateral like a passing comet, while high stake requirements exclude benign edge agents that proliferate like wild yarrow.
